programme.title: Psycho and Psycho Killers
programme.desc: From Norman Bates to Michael Myers and more, these killers love carving up the screen.

programme.title: Get Comfy On the Edge of Your Seat
programme.desc: These heart-racing hits have been thrilling movie audiences for decades.

programme.title: Fatale Femmes Vol. 1: Dangerous Dames
programme.desc: These women play for keeps in the darkest alleys of noir cinema.

programme.title: Fatale Femmes Vol. 2: Seductive & Destructive
programme.desc: From smoldering glances to deadly betrayals, these thrillers show just how far desire can push the human heart.

programme.title: Fatale Femmes Vol. 3: Daughters of Darkness
programme.desc: When horror wears an alluring face, loyalties blur and desire becomes the deadliest curse of all.

programme.title: Joe Dante’s Noir Nightmares
programme.desc: TFH creator Joe Dante celebrates the noir classics that explore themes of identity, paranoia, and duality.

programme.title: Hitchcock: The Master of Suspense
programme.desc: TFH celebrates Alfred Hitchcock and the masterful storytelling that still keeps audiences on the edge of their seats.

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.sub-title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents: The Cheney Vase
programme.desc: A disgraced museum employee schemes to take advantage of a trusting invalid.

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.sub-title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: A seasoned magician takes a simple-minded runaway under his wing, unaware that his wife harbors a sinister plan for the impressionable young man.

programme.title: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: Like your Film Noir with a dash of “Body Heat,” while having dinner in “Chinatown?” Tune in!

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: Frank Sinatra is no angel in this seedy tale of assassins plotting to kill the president during his visit to the small California town of Suddenly.

programme.title: Trailers From Hell
programme.sub-title: Film Noir: The Dark Corner of Cinema
programme.desc: Your favorite filmmakers pull their favorite noir films out of the shadows.

programme.title: D.O.A.
programme.desc: In this noir classic, Edmond O’Brien stars as Frank Bigelow, an accountant who unknowingly swallows deadly toxin and is given days to live. Determined to find out who did it, and why, Frank begins to put the pieces together. But will he find his killer before it’s too late?

programme.title: Mysterious Ways
programme.desc: These mystery movies have gripped audiences for decades. What's their secret?

programme.title: Vincent Price: Master of the Silver Scream
programme.desc: From 'Haunted Hill' to Corman classics, Vincent Price sent shivers down the spines of horror fans for decades.

programme.title: Shock
programme.desc: A distraught young woman witnesses a murder and is committed to a sanitarium by the very man who did it.

programme.title: Hardboiled & Haunted: The Art of Noir Cinema
programme.desc: A gripping collection of noir classics, where crime, corruption, and fate collide on the big screen.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1930s
programme.desc: These are the gothic monsters, mad doctors, and undead terrors that defined the horror genre’s earliest films.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A young man turns to a witch doctor to lure the woman he loves away from her fiancé, but instead turns her into a zombie slave.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1940s Vol. 1
programme.desc: Your favorite filmmakers explore the eerie classics that defined a decade of supernatural thrills and monster madness.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1940s Vol. 2
programme.desc: These 1940s horror films define the decade's fascination with the supernatural and monstrous.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: Vincent Price is throwing a party, and he’s invited five strangers with the promise of $10,000 each, if they can survive the night in the House on Haunted Hill. Director William Castle helmed this 1959 horror hit, which famously utilized the “Emergo” theatrical gimmick to spook moviegoers out of their seats.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1950s Vol. 1
programme.desc: Spine-tingling chills and creature-feature thrills straight from the golden age of drive-in cinema.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1950s Vol. 2
programme.desc: Return to the era of radioactive beasts, twisted experiments, and larger-than-life B-movie terrors.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1960s Vol. 1
programme.desc: From Hitchcock to Corman the 1960s delivered a new era of horror that still haunts the screen.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: Shocked by the death of her spouse, a scheming widow hatches a bold plan to get her hands on the inheritance, unaware that she is targeted by an axe-wielding murderer who lurks in the family's estate. What mystery shrouds the noble house?

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1960s Vol. 2
programme.desc: From gothic chills to sci-fi paranoia, these 1960s shockers pushed horror into strange new realms of dread and imagination.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 1
programme.desc: Enter the realm of 1970s horror, featuring vampiric tales, psychological terror, and innovative creature features.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 2
programme.desc: Explore the grittier side of 1970s horror with a collection of gruesome tales that push the boundaries of blood and mayhem.

programme.title: Decades of Horror: 1970s Vol. 3
programme.desc: Experience the unsettling horror of the 1970s, featuring a mix of psychological tension, supernatural dread, and iconic cult films.

programme.title: Horror Express
programme.desc: Passengers aboard a Trans-Siberian Express train must fight to stay alive after a prehistoric creature escapes captivity and begins a murder spree.
